name: CommandPalette
purpose: A searchable modal command list with grouped actions and optional global shortcut registration.
description: Reach workspace actions through one searchable keyboard surface.

guidance.overview: A searchable modal command list with grouped actions and optional global shortcut registration.
usage: Supply explicit actions with labels, keywords, and callbacks. Searching does not invent an operation or issue a network query.
Disable shortcut registration when embedding a palette where the host already owns the global shortcut.
accessibility: The dialog focuses its command input; Base UI provides active-item navigation and Enter selection.
Escape closes the palette. Focus returns to the opener unless the action deliberately moved focus elsewhere.
context: Use for application navigation and frequent actions that also remain discoverable through visible controls.
